# pi-tui 0.85.1

Frozen installed npm sources. All upstream JS files are byte-identical, no runtime delta. Full MIT license retained; pi-tui license source pi repository d981de1 (package version0.85.1). Declaration files are separately recorded with source hashes/deltas. ports.d.ts is an SDK-only rendering port and shortcut type projection.

The single bare width import is bound at build time to the vendored width index by the private todo config; the metafile rejects npm copies. No minifier/source-string patch changes these bytes.
